categories.name: CSS and design

categories.name: Text tools

categories.name: Images and files

tools.name: JSON Formatter and Validator
tools.card: Check JSON for errors, see the exact line and column, then format or minify it.
tools.title: JSON Formatter and Validator Online
tools.description: Paste JSON to check it for errors and format it with 2 or 4 space indents, or minify it. Errors show the line and column. Runs in your browser.

tools.name: Base64 Encoder and Decoder
tools.card: Encode text or files to Base64, decode it back, or turn images into data URIs for CSS.
tools.title: Base64 Encode and Decode: Text, Files and Images
tools.description: Encode text or files to Base64, decode Base64 back to text, and turn images into data URIs for CSS. UTF-8 and URL-safe Base64 supported.

tools.name: URL Encoder and Decoder
tools.card: Percent-encode text for links and query strings, or decode encoded URLs.
tools.title: URL Encoder and Decoder (Percent-Encoding)
tools.description: Percent-encode text for URLs and query strings, or decode encoded URLs back to plain text. Handles UTF-8, strict RFC 3986 mode and + as space.

tools.name: Password Policy Regex Generator
tools.card: Turn password rules into a regex and HTML pattern, test passwords and generate strong ones.
tools.title: Password Policy Regex Generator and Checker
tools.description: Set password rules and get a ready-made regex and HTML pattern, test passwords against them, and generate strong passwords with secure randomness.

tools.name: Random Number Generator
tools.card: Pick one or many random numbers in any range, with or without duplicates.
tools.title: Random Number Generator: Any Range, No Duplicates
tools.description: Generate one or many random numbers between any two values, with or without duplicates, sorted or not. Uses your browser's secure random source.

tools.name: CSS Gradient Generator
tools.card: Build linear and radial gradients with up to six colors and copy CSS or a Tailwind class.
tools.title: CSS Gradient Generator with Tailwind Code
tools.description: Build linear and radial CSS gradients with up to 6 colors and a live preview. Copy the CSS or a Tailwind class for your project.

tools.name: CSS Box Shadow Generator
tools.card: Adjust offset, blur, spread and color, then copy CSS or a Tailwind class.
tools.title: CSS Box Shadow Generator with Tailwind Code
tools.description: Set offset, blur, spread, color and opacity for a CSS box shadow and see it live. Copy plain CSS or the matching Tailwind arbitrary class.

tools.name: CSS Button Hover Effect Generator
tools.card: Design a button with gradient, shadow and hover animations, then copy the CSS and HTML.
tools.title: CSS Button Hover Effect Generator
tools.description: Design a CSS button with gradient, shadow and hover effects such as slide fills, lift and scale. Live preview, then copy the CSS and HTML.

tools.name: Color Palette Generator
tools.card: Generate 5-color palettes from real color schemes and check text contrast.
tools.title: Color Palette Generator with Contrast Checker
tools.description: Generate 5-color palettes from analogous, triadic, complementary or monochrome schemes, lock colors you like and check WCAG contrast.

tools.name: HEX to RGB and HSL Converter
tools.card: Convert colors between HEX, RGB and HSL, including transparency.
tools.title: HEX to RGB and HSL Color Converter
tools.h1: HEX, RGB and HSL Color Converter
tools.description: Convert colors between HEX, RGB and HSL, including 8-digit HEX with transparency and RGBA. Pick a color or type a code to convert.

tools.name: Word and Character Counter
tools.card: Count words, characters, sentences and reading time as you type.
tools.title: Word Counter and Character Counter
tools.description: Count words, characters with and without spaces, sentences and paragraphs as you type, with reading time and the words you use most.

tools.name: Case Converter
tools.card: Switch text between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case and Sentence case.
tools.title: Case Converter: Upper, Lower, Title and Sentence
tools.description: Change text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, alternating or inverse case. Works with accented letters and many paragraphs.

tools.name: List Cleaner
tools.card: Remove duplicate and blank lines, trim spaces and sort any list.
tools.title: Remove Duplicate Lines and Clean Up Lists
tools.h1: Remove Duplicate Lines and Clean Up a List
tools.description: Paste a list to remove duplicate and blank lines, trim spaces, sort A to Z or Z to A and change case. Ignores case and spacing if you want.

tools.name: Fancy Font Generator
tools.card: Write in bold, italic, script and other Unicode styles for social media bios.
tools.title: Fancy Font Generator for Instagram Bios
tools.description: Type your text and copy it in bold, italic, script, fraktur and other Unicode styles for Instagram bios, captions and comments. No app needed.

tools.name: WebP Converter
tools.card: Convert images between WebP, PNG and JPG and resize them, without uploading.
tools.title: WebP Converter: WebP to PNG and JPG to WebP
tools.h1: WebP, PNG and JPG Image Converter
tools.description: Convert images between WebP, PNG and JPG, resize them and set quality, with transparency kept. Images are processed in your browser, never uploaded.

tools.name: PDF to JPG Converter
tools.card: Turn every page of a PDF into a JPG and download them as one ZIP.
tools.title: PDF to JPG Converter: All Pages to a ZIP
tools.description: Turn every page of a PDF into a JPG image and download them together as a ZIP. Choose image quality and size. Your PDF never leaves your device.

tools.name: Should I Buy This? Calculator
tools.card: See how long a purchase takes to pay for itself in time saved.
tools.title: Should I Buy This? Time-Saving Purchase Calculator
tools.description: See how long a purchase takes to pay for itself in time saved, what it costs in hours of work, and what the money could grow to if invested.
